decisions.question: 현재 여섯 Notebook을 Crawl Notebook v1 source로 동결할지
decisions.evidence: Source integrity/parity passes, but six P1 defects remain.
decisions.impact: Production lineage and order are trustworthy only after patch.

decisions.question: M1.5 의미적 QA를 production crawl 전에 수행할지
decisions.evidence: Structural QA passes while full-corpus semantics and gold validation are NOT_EVALUATED.
decisions.impact: Prevents structurally valid but semantically weak data from becoming production input.

decisions.question: asset 수집을 CRAWL_RELEASE_READY 필수조건으로 유지할지
decisions.evidence: 59 candidates/30 OCR candidates exist, but fetched assets=0 and gate is NOT_EVALUATED.
options: Allow text-only release with explicit eligibility exclusion
